description:
Validate vault files against the schemas in the schemas directory.

Usage: lint [PATH ...] [--schemas DIR] [--quiet]

Args:
  PATH — zero or more files to validate. With none, walks the whole vault and validates everything.

Flags:
  --schemas DIR — schemas directory; defaults to the schemas directory shipped alongside the tool.
  --quiet — suppress per-violation output, leaving only the exit code.

Examples:
  []
  ["--quiet"]
  ["notes/2026-09-10-14-30-00.md", "threads/Projects/SGB.md"]

Notes:
  Violations print as <path>:<line>: <message>.
  Exit code 0 when clean, 1 when any violations are found, 2 on a usage or startup failure. A non-zero exit is the expected signal, not a tool malfunction.
  Read-only; it never modifies files.
  Run after any batch of writes and before `commit save`.
